verdict.rationale: Cloudflare Registrar's only background behavior in the evidence is built-in default auto-renewal of domains. That is a fixed renewal feature, not user-configurable automations that run autonomously. The Registrar API and the platform-level MCP server are developer building blocks or host-platform items, so they earn no credit toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
